author: janpettermg
body:
This PR lowers the minimum supported Python version from 3.11 to 3.10.

The codebase has been verified to run without modification on Python 3.10, and no 3.11-specific language features or standard library APIs are required. Requiring 3.11 therefore imposes a higher version floor than technically necessary. Adjusting the minimum version better reflects actual compatibility and reduces unnecessary upgrade pressure for users.

### Key changes

- Updated `pyproject.toml` to set requires-python to >=3.10
- Adjusted CI matrix to test against Python 3.10

### Impact

- Expands compatibility to users still running Python 3.10
- No functional or behavioral changes to the project
- No additional maintenance burden, as CI validates both minimum and latest supported versions
- Makes the version requirement technically accurate rather than symbolic

### Motivation
- Provide a mobile-first WebAR-lite experience that maps a phone camera view to a recommended "tea mood" and poetic micro-output, while keeping all processing on-device for privacy.
- Deliver a premium, cinematic UI with subtle aura overlays and a short brew-ritual animation to make the mapping feel poetic and tactile.
- Use lightweight deterministic heuristics (frame stats + time + location hint) to avoid heavy ML or binary assets and ensure fast on-device behavior.

### Description
- Scaffolds a Next.js App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind project and base CSS (`app/globals.css`, `next.config.ts`, `tsconfig.json`, `tailwind.config.ts`, `postcss.config.js`, `package.json`).
- Implements the single-page flow and state machine (`idle → requesting → scanning → recommended → locked/error`) in `app/page.tsx`, including camera permission handling, demo mode, iOS-friendly video attributes, location hint selector, and share snapshot composition.
- Adds camera/video capture and sampling components: `components/CameraView.tsx` (getUserMedia, rear-camera preferred, graceful denied/unsupported handling) and `components/useFrameStats.ts` (throttled sampling ~4Hz, computes `avgBrightness`, `avgSaturation`, `avgWarmth`, and `motionLevel` via frame-diffing).
- Implements deterministic recommendation heuristics and location/time bias in `lib/recommendation.ts`, plus mood cycling (`getNextMood`) and stable-detection before showing recommendations.
- Provides the six tea moods and exact micro-poems plus visual tokens in `data/teaMoods.ts`, and a premium overlay in `components/AuraOverlay.tsx` (radial aura gradients, vignette, animated grain) with reduced-motion support.
- Adds a 5-step “brew ritual” animation component `components/RitualAnimation.tsx` that runs 15–25s (adapted for reduced motion) and UI controls for `Rescan`, `Lock this mood`, `Try another`, and `Share` (composites a shareable PNG via canvas and Web Share API fallback).
- All analysis and mapping run entirely in-browser; there is no network upload of camera frames or user data.

### Testing

- No automated typecheck/build/test run was possible because package installation was blocked, so `next dev`, `next build`, `eslint`, and `tsc --noEmit` were not executed here.

# Add docs and tests for CWL log group retention/size filtering

## Summary

Addresses #500 — filtering CloudWatch Log groups by `retentionInDays` and `storedBytes`.

No new filter classes are introduced. The existing `ValueFilter` (`type: value`) already supports filtering on these attributes since they are returned directly by the `describe_log_groups` API. This PR documents and tests that capability.

**Changes:**
- Added a docstring to the `LogGroup` resource manager class (`c7n/resources/cw.py`) with four YAML policy examples covering: absent retention, retention threshold, size threshold, and combined retention+size filtering
- Added 6 new unit tests to `tests/test_cwl.py` exercising `retentionInDays` (absent, present, greater-than) and `storedBytes` (greater-than, equal-zero, combined with retention)
- Added 3 new placebo fixture directories with hand-crafted `DescribeLogGroups` and `GetResources` response data

**Key design decision:** `retentionInDays` is omitted entirely from the API response when no retention policy is set (it's not `null`, the key is absent). The `value: absent` / `value: present` syntax in `ValueFilter` handles this correctly.

## Review & Testing Checklist for Human

- [ ] Verify the docstring YAML examples are valid Cloud Custodian policy syntax (indentation, key names) — these will render in Sphinx docs
- [ ] Confirm the placebo fixture data structure matches real `describe_log_groups` API responses (hand-crafted, not recorded from AWS)
- [ ] Run `pytest tests/test_cwl.py -k "test_retention_filter or test_size_filter or test_no_retention_and_large"` locally to verify all 6 new tests pass

### Notes
- All tests pass locally (6/6) and lint is clean
- Placebo fixtures use synthetic data with a reused account ID (`644160558196`) consistent with existing fixtures
